entities.name: Table T1 – US Data Center Landscape of Americas Planned Data Centers
entities.brief: Planned data center capacity in GW across Americas categories
entities.description: Horizontal stacked bar chart showing planned vs commissioned capacity by category

properties.table_content:
| Category                  | Planned Commissioned Capacity (GW) | Total Planned (GW) |
|---------------------------|------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Americas - Colo           | 4.7                                | 43.6               |
| Americas - Hyperscale     | 3.7                                | -                  |
| Americas total - Overall  | 8.5                                | 47.4               |
properties.key_insight: Total planned capacity (47.4 GW) significantly exceeds planned commissioned capacity (8.5 GW), led by colocation's 43.6 GW pipeline.
